methodology: R8/resources, fixed GeckoView158.0.20261021001945, x86_64 fresh Google APIs VMs, configured4096MiB and actual two logical CPUs; physical and real ChatGPT performance are unverified.

App-only comparison uses bounded observer in both arms and the same app module source and dependency/ABI/R8 configuration, apart from the explicit tuning flag; tuning flag selects legacy versus optimized code. API35 later source changes only input preparation, not the App.
90-second streaming/duplicate-notification stress,180-second Home and180-second forced Doze, then all original17 recovery assertions.
CPU is device-time-weighted attributable process utime+stime, one logical core=100%;30-second windows. PSS sampled approximately every60 seconds; sampled peaks are not instantaneous peaks.
Single matched runs, not statistical or universal percentage guarantees. Actual notification/mutation throughput and page writes are retained for interpretation.

Observer transport repair is separately labelled. Legacy observer had up to362 independently received outstanding fetch promises per page; bounded transport holds at most one. No claim that this explains all PSS growth or constitutes App performance improvement.

The first unrestricted snapshot suppression candidate failed forward restoration; it is rejected. Accepted coalescing is permitted only after native ready, with restoration/checkpoint/handshake progress retained.
No root/device policy exemptions were added for the App; fresh CI root is limited to test evidence. No forced GC, trimming, disabling recovery or dropping final streaming content was used.

Memory is not uniformly lower: stress sample peaks decreased, some post-stress/Doze endpoints were higher. This does not establish that all memory growth or a memory leak was fixed.
No production client,main,public release,website,existing login or production signing data changed.

Both current optimized APIs passed one sequential30-minute Home/screen-off/forced-Doze round and all original17 recovery checks,20 per API; every accepted long observer sample was bounded to one active promise.
